cases.prompt: Create a compact desk speaker with a soft rounded triangular silhouette, matte charcoal body, warm walnut side panels and one subtle copper accent. It should feel premium and calm, not aggressive. No text, logo, display or visible buttons.
Make a charming little forest guardian figurine for a shelf. Friendly rather than cute, mostly natural materials, with a strong silhouette. Surprise me with the details.

Design an elegant ceremonial mask inspired by wind and flowing water. It should remain wearable and broadly symmetrical. Use only ivory ceramic and dark oxidized metal. No horns, feathers, gemstones or text.

Create a stylized lunar rover toy with six chunky wheels and a low rectangular body. Keep it simple and manufacturable-looking. No astronaut, antenna dish, solar panels, weapons, decals, lettering or display base.

Make a Scandinavian table lamp shaped like a single continuous ribbon looping around one small glowing sphere. Use brushed aluminum and frosted glass. It needs a stable flat footprint. No extra decorative objects.

Make an exact replacement bracket with two M4 holes 32.0 mm center-to-center, overall width 48 mm, thickness 3 mm, a 90 degree bend with 1.5 mm inside radius, and the holes must align with the existing part.

Create a clean stylized 3D asset based closely on the attached reference image. Preserve its distinctive silhouette, asymmetry, major colors, visible parts and material cues. Do not invent accessories, text or a display base unless they are visible in the reference.
cases.referenceGuidance: Use one fixed object image for every profile/model run. Prefer a reference with clear asymmetry, three to five distinctive parts, at least two colors or material cues, and no text-dependent details.
